items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: When I joined the band the trumpets were Langston Curl -- he was playing first trumpet. Joe Smith was out but he came back -- and Buddy Lee, George Oliver Buddy Lee.

ctx.x: Who were all the guys in that band -- this, again, I'm trying to recapture this band of McKinney's -- when you joined it?

When I joined the band the trumpets were Langston Curl -- he was playing first trumpet. Joe Smith was out but he came back -- and Buddy Lee, George Oliver Buddy Lee. And, by the way, he's Jonah Jones' cousin.
